description: Install the first-party WebMCP Today native bridge for macOS Chrome or Brave. This copies a fixed bundled host to ~/.config/webmcp-today and writes only this bridge's native-messaging manifest under ~/Library/Application Support. Set confirm to true to approve these writes.

confirm.description: Must be true to approve the bridge installation.

extensionId.description: Development-only override. Public setup otherwise uses the official release ID.

name: setup_webmcp_bridge
